items.title: Vercel Agent sessions now cost 67% less
items.summary: Vercel Agent sessions in the dashboard and Slack now cost 67% less on average. We rebuilt how Agent manages context, reducing the tokens needed per session and improving prompt-cache reuse. These improvements are live and require no action. What changed:  are unchanged. Paid sessions are billed at the model provider’s inference rates plus a Vercel Agent fee of $0.25 per million tokens. View usage and costs in the  of your dashboard.Vercel Agent’s billing ratesAgent sectionRead more Updated Vercel CLI skills give agents clearer guidance for common workflows and error recovery. Other agents using these skills also benefit.Workflow-based CLI skills: Agent manages context more efficiently as conversations grow, including long Slack threads.Incremental context management: Agent preserves more reusable context across turns so more of it can be read from the cache.Improved prompt caching: Updated guidance helps Agent plan changes and write code with fewer tokens.More efficient coding and planning:
